 Aadhaar and DigiLocker Guidelines for JEE Main 2027 Candidates 
 The registration process for JEE Main 2027 Session 1 is underway, and candidates are advised to complete their applications before the prescribed deadline.
 With a large number of students expected to register for the examination, the National Testing Agency (NTA) has issued an important advisory regarding discrepancies between Aadhaar photographs, live photographs and identity details available on DigiLocker.
 The advisory is particularly important for candidates who have recently updated their Aadhaar details, including their photograph and biometric information.
 NTA has instructed such applicants to ensure that their latest identification details are reflected in their DigiLocker accounts before filling out the JEE Main 2027 application form.
 NTA Highlights Photo Mismatch Issues During JEE Main Registration 
 Several candidates have reportedly encountered difficulties during registration because their live photographs do not match the photographs available on their Aadhaar cards or other identity documents. In some cases, students updated their Aadhaar photographs but continued using outdated information stored in their DigiLocker accounts.
 To address these issues, NTA has advised candidates to use their updated identification details while completing the application process.
 Students who have made any changes to their Aadhaar information should complete the re-KYC process on DigiLocker and refresh their documents to ensure that the latest details are available.
 Why Should Candidates Update Their DigiLocker Accounts? 
 DigiLocker is being used as an important identity verification option during the JEE Main 2027 application process. If a candidate’s Aadhaar information has been updated but the DigiLocker account still displays the previous photograph or details, it may create discrepancies during identity verification.
 Therefore, candidates should refresh their Aadhaar information on DigiLocker before proceeding with registration. This will help ensure that the photograph and identification details retrieved during the application process correspond to their latest Aadhaar records.
 NTA has also advised candidates who have updated their biometric information or made other changes to Aadhaar to complete re-KYC before submitting their applications.
 How to Complete DigiLocker Re-KYC for JEE Main 2027 
 Candidates can update their DigiLocker accounts by following these steps:
 Visit the official DigiLocker website and log in using your registered credentials.
 Open the section containing your issued or uploaded documents.
 Locate and select your Aadhaar card.
 Click on the refresh option available alongside the Aadhaar document.
 Complete the verification process by entering the OTP received on your registered mobile number.
 Once the verification is successful, your updated Aadhaar information will be refreshed in your DigiLocker account.
 After completing these steps, candidates should ensure that their latest photograph and identification details are correctly reflected in DigiLocker before filling out the JEE Main 2027 application form.
 Important Instructions for Candidates Who Have Updated Aadhaar 
 Students who have recently changed their Aadhaar photographs, corrected personal information or updated biometric details should pay special attention to the NTA advisory. Updating Aadhaar alone may not automatically refresh the information already available in DigiLocker.
 Candidates should therefore complete the re-KYC process and refresh their Aadhaar documents before using DigiLocker for JEE Main registration. This precaution can help prevent avoidable problems arising from outdated photographs or mismatched identification details.
 Students who have already submitted their application using old identification information should carefully review the instructions issued by NTA and follow the official guidelines applicable to their situation.
 JEE Main 2027 Registration: Apply Before the Deadline 
 With registrations continuing, candidates are advised not to wait until the last date to complete the application process. They should verify their personal details, Aadhaar information, photograph and other required documents before submitting the form.
 As the number of applicants is expected to increase in the coming days, completing the registration process early can help students avoid last-minute technical difficulties.
 Candidates should regularly visit the official JEE Main website for the latest notifications, application-related updates and instructions from NTA. Following the DigiLocker re-KYC advisory is particularly important for students who have recently updated their Aadhaar details.
